# AHA NexCruise

> Plug-and-play cruise control upgrades for Indian cars, with car-specific harness fitment, brake override, OTA firmware support, WhatsApp support, and optional wireless steering dial controls.

## Primary Pages

- Home and product overview: https://ahanexcruise.com/
- Product system: https://ahanexcruise.com/#product
- Live compatibility check: https://ahanexcruise.com/#compatibility
- NexCruise Basic and Smart comparison: https://ahanexcruise.com/#variants
- Installation flow: https://ahanexcruise.com/#installation

## Product Summary

AHA NexCruise is an aftermarket automotive cruise-control system designed for Indian roads. The site explains two customer-facing packages:

- NexCruise Basic: essential cruise-control package with car-specific fitment and brake override.
- NexCruise Smart: full control package with wireless steering dial, drive modes, resume control, speed governor, and migration support.

## Important Details

- Compatibility is checked using server-side NCV2 vehicle data.
- The product uses model-specific harness fitment instead of generic wire cutting.
- Customer support and lead handoff use WhatsApp at +91 83069 24400.
- Official support email: support@aha3d.in.
- Location: I/F-2, Solitaire Park, Ajmer Road, Jaipur, Rajasthan 303007.
